thread:
kai: Heads-up: customer reported quota hit + unexpected provisional charge after a stream reconnect during a canary routing rollout. seems like quota checks and provisional emissions race.
maria: Logs?
kai: session=sldr-77, route=canary-A -> then routing rolled to canary-B mid-stream. snippet:
```
10:41:02 REQ sess=sldr-77 route=canary-A prefix=15
10:41:04 STREAM_TRUNC sess=sldr-77 trunc=2 provisional=true quota_remain_before=3
10:41:05 ROUTE_ROLLOUT_APPLY route=canary-B
10:41:06 RECONNECT sess=sldr-77 route=canary-B
10:41:06 QUOTA_ENFORCE sess=sldr-77 allow=false reason=quota_exhausted
10:41:07 STREAM_RESUME sess=sldr-77 resumed=8 confirmed=true
BILL provisional: 15+2 route=canary-A
BILL confirmed: 8 route=canary-B
```
kai: Customer got provisional visible charge that pushed them over quota, then resume was blocked by quota enforcement but somehow confirmed still landed partially. messy.
dan: probably two separate systems: provisional emission doesn't consult final quota reservation. provisional was emitted before quota enforcement landed for the resumed route.
billing-bot: Alert: provisional_quota_race detected for sess=sldr-77 delta=2 tokens
olivia: we need clear invariant: provisional events should never cause a customer-visible over-quota state. either provisional is only an estimate (no enforcement) or provisional must check against *bound* of quota.
maria: options: (1) provisional no-op in billing ledger (only telemetry) until confirm (fast but removes early visibility), (2) provisional checks quota reservation across potential fallback routes (hard), (3) provisional emits but is marked as non-chargeable until confirmed and we surface in UI as "pending estimate" with no quota impact.
kai: I like (3). display in console a non-blocking provisional row and ensure quota enforcement only looks at confirmed/committed tokens.
dan: but some customers rely on provisional to throttle themselves. if provisional has no quota effect they can't self-limit. maybe add a flag per-account to opt into quota-honoring provisional.
olivia: we should default to not letting provisional reduce quota but add an account setting "provisional_counts_toward_quota" for enterprise customers who opt-in. rollout behind feature flag.
maria: telemetry: emit metric provisional_causes_overquota boolean and routing_rollout_in_progress tag. add dashboard panel for provisional vs confirmed delta and quota hits during rollouts.
sam: test matrix needed: normal streams, stream+route-rollout, stream+toolcall interleave, provisional burst, enterprise opt-in. also unit tests for quota decision path: provisional -> no change, confirm -> apply.
maria: UI change: add hover explaining provisional semantics and a separate quota meter for "confirmed usage" vs "provisional estimate". put a warning if provisional_estimate pushes near quota but make it non-blocking unless account opt-in.
dan: backend: implement provisional.flag=estimate, ledger writes as metadata-only; confirmed does charge and reduces quota. reconciliation job will reconcile estimates and create adjustments.
kai: owner/next steps: olivia owns policy + feature flag, dan owns ledger change, maria owns UI, sam writes tests and telemetry. I'll open a support follow-up for the impacted customer and propose a one-time credit if reconciliation shows double counting.
olivia: will draft rollout plan: feature-flag default off for provisional-quota, gradual enable for opt-in accounts, monitor provisional_causes_overquota metric.
billing-bot: Info: provisional_quota_race_alert created id=PQ-2026-594 
maria: please link PRs and I'll add to next console patch notes. thanks all.
